settings.question: Is this one device for both knees?
settings.answer: Yes. Kneora has two separate knee openings within one housing, divided at the center.

settings.question: What functions does it include?
settings.answer: Heating, vibration, air compression, and red and blue light functions.

settings.question: What is the difference between the packages?
settings.answer: Both packages contain the same dual-knee device. The second package also includes after-care gel.

settings.question: How large is it?
settings.answer: The overall dimensions are 360 × 242 × 160 mm. These are external measurements, not the internal knee fitting range.

settings.headline: You put in the work. Make time for your knees.
settings.subhead: Heat, vibration, air compression, and red and blue light in one dual-knee device. Make Kneora part of your routine when the boots come off.

settings.text: A single continuous housing accommodates both knees together, with a divider at the center.

settings.title: Controls within view

settings.heading: Built into your evening.
settings.text: On the tools. On your feet. Down at floor level. Skilled work asks a lot of you. Your time at home deserves consideration, too.

settings.heading: Two packages. The same dual-knee device.
More ways to wind down. One device.
settings.text: When the boots come off, make some room for yourself. Kneora brings several functions into one device for both knees.

settings.title: Warmth
settings.text: A built-in heating function adds warmth to your knee-care routine.

settings.title: Vibration
settings.text: Vibration massage is built into the dual-knee housing.

settings.title: Air compression
settings.text: An air-compression function adds another massage option.

settings.title: Red and blue light
settings.text: Both light functions are included in the device’s feature set.

settings.question: Is Kneora a soft knee wrap?
settings.answer: No. It is a rigid device with an ABS outer shell and padded knee channels.

settings.question: Where can I find operating instructions?
settings.answer: Follow the instructions supplied with your device for positioning, settings, use and care.

settings.question: Does the gel package use a different device?
settings.answer: No. Both package options contain the same dual-knee device. The gel is the additional item.

settings.question: Do the overall dimensions tell me whether it will fit?
settings.answer: No. Overall dimensions describe the outside of the device. Contact the store for internal fitting measurements before ordering if you are unsure.
